podcast.body: Conceived and produced by Joe Meek in 1960, this album is possibly the first conceptual rock album in history. It presents a musical fantasy about outer space, heavily employing echoes, reverbs, and pitch modulation of voices to simulate alien sounds. It also uniquely uses modified household sounds to evoke the vastness of space, and this album significantly predated the later success of Space Music. "Es el mismo año mi concebió y produjo a Hira New World, posiblemente el primer disco conceptual de la historia del rock, una fantasía musical sobre el espacio exterior, repleta de ecos, reverbs, modulación del pitch de las voces para simular la voz extraterrestre o el uso de sonidos caseros modificados para simular el espacio."
